title: Add an OpenAPI client
description: Writes an openapi-client.json. The @nx-plugin-openapi/core/plugin Nx plugin infers the generate target and the generated libs from it.

name.description: Client name; project names and aliases derive from it (e.g. petstore -> petstore-api)
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the client?

directory.description: Directory of the client, relative to the workspace root (e.g. libs/shared/petstore)
directory.x-prompt: Which directory should hold the client (e.g. libs/shared/petstore)?

scope.description: Adds a 'scope:<scope>' tag to all projects of the client

spec.description: Local spec path (relative to the workspace root) or URL. A URL is downloaded once to <directory>/<name>.openapi.json|yaml and stored for update-spec
spec.x-prompt: Where is the OpenAPI spec (local path or URL)?

adapter.description: Generator plugin (adapter) written to the definition's generator field. Named adapter because nx g reserves --generator

x-prompt.message: Which generator adapter would you like to use?

split.description: Split the generated code into types, api and core libs

importPrefix.description: Prefix of the split lib aliases, e.g. '@acme' -> '@acme/petstore-api'. Default: the npm scope of the root package.json

addToGitignore.description: Add the generated directories to .gitignore and .prettierignore
